contract_line: The teams holding their queues aren't the ones with more headcount, they're the ones turning quiet hours into coaching before a heavy fortnight lands.
vm_hook: The teams that hold the line seem to be the ones who use their quiet hours deliberately, rather than just being relieved when they show up.
voice_script: Hi Louise, it's Jack Ohagan. Every complaints operation has quiet pockets in the week, and the difference I see is whether those minutes turn into coaching and case-clearing or just evaporate. When intake jumped last year, the teams that had used those pockets held their queues, and the ones that hadn't watched cases age towards the ombudsman. How deliberately does your operation use its quiet hours today?
